We have a Rocq formalization with 0 Axiom, 0 Admitted, 20 .v files. All compile with -vos (type-level checking). But psi_cdindex_tree.v (and its predecessor psi_cdindex_tree_hlc.v) OOM during -vo compilation at ~131GB (cgroup memory limit).

The project has been stuck iterating on the same approach: split files, wrap in abstract(), extract forall bodies. None of these fundamentally solve the problem because the underlying proofs generate exponentially large proof terms from nested case splits in strong induction.

We need a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT approach. Please investigate:

## Option 1: coqchk
Can we use `coqchk` (Coq's standalone proof checker) to verify .vo files? Does it exist in this installation? Run: `opam exec -- which coqchk 2>/dev/null; opam exec -- coqchk --help 2>/dev/null | head -5`. coqchk verifies proof terms but may handle memory differently.

## Option 2: -vos is enough
The -vos compilation checks ALL type signatures, definitions, and proof obligations. The -vo compilation ADDITIONALLY re-checks proof bodies (which are opaque anyway). Is -vos verification mathematically sufficient? What exactly does -vos skip vs -vo?

Read: https://coq.inria.fr/doc/V8.18/refman/practical-tools/coq-commands.html (or search for documentation on -vos)

## Option 3: Separate kernel checking
Can we compile to -vos and then run a separate pass to check just the proof bodies? Maybe `coqc -vok` or similar?

## Option 4: Reduce proof term size at the source
The heavy lemmas use `elim=> [|n IH]` (strong induction) + `case: (ltngtP i j)` (3-way case split). Read psi_core.v to see how SIMILAR proofs compile fine there (psi_core.vo is only 312KB). What's different about psi_cdindex_tree.v? Run:
```
ls -lh psi_core.vo psi_comm.vo psi_descent_v2.vo psi_descent_thms.vo
wc -l psi_core.v psi_comm.v psi_descent_v2.v psi_descent_thms.v
```
Compare proof patterns between files that compile and the one that doesn't.

## Option 5: Enable native_compute
Check if we can enable `-native-compiler ondemand` in _CoqProject. Native compilation handles proof terms differently and may avoid the serialization blowup.

## Option 6: Proof irrelevance / SProp
Can we declare some proof-only types as SProp (strict propositions) so Rocq erases proof terms during compilation?

Report which options are viable and recommend the best path forward. Be concrete — show exact commands, not just ideas.

Workspace: /scratch/lelarge/mathcomp-eulerian

16	Definition max_pos (s : seq nat) : nat :=
17	  index (foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s)) s.
18	
19	Definition mm_pos (s : seq nat) : nat :=
20	  if min_pos s <= max_pos s then min_pos s else max_pos s.

22	Lemma max_in s a : foldr maxn a s \in a :: s.

25	  by rewrite inE eqxx.

27	case: leqP => _.

  index (foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s)) s.
